name: Simon V. Maier
headline: ARCHIVIST
summary:
Experience in the venture capital, startups, and consulting.

I am experienced in new business creation and commercialization. Go-to-market strategy, venture financing, startup growth, as well as management consulting are among my focus areas. I have experience with digital Marketplaces, Q-Commerce, FinTech, HR-Tech, Mobility Tech and more. I hold a Master in Business Administration, a graduate Honor's Degree in Technology Management, and spent graduate visits in Silicon Valley.

Work experience at: Picus Capital, arive, BCG DV, Combyne, DasBoep, Casana and more
Education from: CDTM, LMU Munich, UC Berkeley, Stanford GSB

positions.title: Vice President of Marketplace
positions.description:
Pre-Seed until Series A: Started with the two founders until brand partnerships (e.g. CLOSED, DIPTYQUE, HAY) across consignment, connected-retail, and wholesale models surpassed 120 and we were live in four major cities.

Investors include La Famiglia, Balderton Capital, 468 Capital, Burda Principal Investors.
Acquired by quick commerce unicorn ZAPP (https://www.justzapp.com/).

positions.title: BD & Strategy Lead (EiR)
positions.description:
I helped build Casana, a Picus Capital pre-seed portfolio company until founders joined. Casana was acquired by SoftBank-backed tech unicorn Andela in 2023.

Casana was founded as a global managed marketplace for the best product owners, software engineers, and digital designers - among other exciting projects, we are building digital products for the renewable energy space (mobile apps), e-commerce companies (shop system/crm), and venture capital firms (automated investment sourcing).

positions.title: Associate
positions.description:
I focus on pre-seed investments and their support especially regarding go-to-market strategy, growth, and digital product development related topics.

Picus Capital is mainly focused on investments in Prop Tech (e.g. Zeus Living), Fin Tech (e.g. Billie), HR Tech (e.g. Personio), Mobility Tech (e.g. Finn.Auto), Food Tech (e.g. Miscusi), and Renewable Energy (e.g. Enpal).

positions.title: Investment Analyst
positions.description: Picus Capital is an early-stage technology investment firm with a long-term investment philosophy. We work together with promising internet ventures to build successful, global companies.

positions.title: Assistant to CEO
positions.description:
Combyne is a data insights and marketing platform provider with 1.5mio users in 2018. Combyne raised 5.9m Euro from investors sofar.

I worked on various fundraising and B2B sales-related projects with the Founder&CEO (on-site at Plug&Play's RetailTech Hub in Munich and remote).

positions.title: Venture Finance Consulting
positions.description:
Boep is an organic beauty company, the products are now sold at 2000+ stores including DM and one of the founders made it on Forbes 30 under 30 list in Europe 2019.

I consulted founders on funding strategy, successfully attracted investment offers.

positions.title: Visiting Venture Architect
positions.description:
Boston Consulting Group Digital Ventures is a corporate investment and incubation firm. We invent, build and invest in startups with the world’s most influential companies. We share risk and invest alongside our corporate and startup partners via a range of collaborative options.

I mainly worked on the go-to-market, expansion strategy, as well as loyalty program design for a corporate mobility venture in incubation stage.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Initially platform development for temporary retail collaborations and urban space rentals supported by LMU EC / Munich RE / UnternehmerTUM / CDTM / Stanford / Rid Stiftung - refocused since Q2 2017

Participated in two competitive accelerator programs, received multiple 6-digit investment offers.

positions.title: Student Venture Partner
positions.description:
My major tasks included scouting start-up teams and evaluating them with the 8D Methodology.

Regular meetings with founder.org management - organized a Munich ecosystem tour and start-up pitch event for founder.org representatives.

Venture Partners discover and support the best ideas in their ecosystem, bringing FOUNER.org financial, educational and mentoring resources to young innovator teams who want to build world changing companies.

positions.title: Interim Owner & MD
positions.description:
Change management: Detach business to a stand alone operation, set up legal and insurances, scale partner network, redesign online presence, retransfer ownership.

Served about 2,000 sports travelers per season.
